payload.purpose_context: doc-kitty renders a repository's docs tree as a human-first, agent-supported site. Mission M5 lets anyone author a diagram as a plain Markdown code fence and have it render (client-side in v1) as a brand-themed, accessible figure — with a caption and an accessible description authored in the diagram's own comment syntax — on both documentation pages and slide decks, with no external service and a readable no-JS fallback. Build-time static-SVG pre-render and PlantUML are a tracked follow-up (issue #13).
payload.purpose_tldr: Authors write Mermaid diagrams in Markdown; they render in the browser as themed, accessible figures on docs and slide decks.
